title: Comparison of closed support with the transported finite exceptional value
statement:
Fix the finite-field and finite-coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic $p$, $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $\varpi_E$ is a uniformizer and $n\geq1$, with $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $Z,X$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion of $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion], with quasi-compact open complement $j:V\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Work with ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites and their derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], let $B_0=Ri^!_0K$, where $Ri^!_0$ is the right derived functor on $D^+$ of $M\mapsto i^{-1}\ker(M\to j_*j^*M)$ [def-pur-flasque-support], with support-adjunction counit $\epsilon_0:i_*B_0\to K$. Assume that $B_0$ is bounded with intrinsically constructible cohomology, namely $B_0\in D^b_c(Z,A)$ in [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility].

Use $c=(\mathrm{id}_Z,i)$ as compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and let
$$B=Ri^!K=\nu_Z^*i_c^\times R\nu_{X,*}K$$
be the finite exceptional value of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], where $i_c^\times$ is the ordinary etale compact-support right adjoint and $\nu_T$ is the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For each bounded-below object $T$ of etale origin [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], denote by
$$a_T:\operatorname{Hom}(T,B_0)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(i_*T,K),\qquad e_T:\operatorname{Hom}(T,B)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}(i_*T,K)$$
the support adjunction of [lem-pur-support-localization-triangle] and the relative exceptional adjunction of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class](2) at $c$, respectively; $i_*$ denotes its exact termwise derived functor. Both $B_0$ and $B$ are bounded below of etale origin. There is a unique isomorphism $\phi_K:B_0\xrightarrow{\sim}B$ such that, for every such $T$ and every $f:T\to B_0$,
$$e_T(\phi_K\circ f)=a_T(f).$$
In particular, writing $\epsilon=e_B(1_B)$, one has
$$\epsilon\circ i_*\phi_K=\epsilon_0.$$
All Hom groups are taken in the ordinary derived categories of the indicated pro-etale module sheaves.

source.place: First paragraph, identification of the first support-triangle term with the exceptional inverse image. Agent-extracted comparison obligation, after the support value is computed; Stacks Categories Tag 001P (lemma-yoneda) is the representability input, and Pro-etale Tag 09BM (lemma-closed-immersion-complement-retrocompact-exact) is the closed-exactness input. These tags alone do not assert the etale/pro-etale comparison.

proof.text: Use the supplied support adjunction S ⊣ R₀. For B₀ = R₀(K), intrinsic bounded constructibility gives a finite set of nonzero cohomology degrees. Finite lower and upper bounds give a closed integer interval containing them, including when that set is empty. Apply the essential-image criterion of lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin to its canonical constant-scalar realization. The resulting etale complex is bounded below. The exact realization equivalence is fully faithful on derived categories, so lift its comparison isomorphism to the fixed-module category. This proves that B₀ is bounded below of etale origin, rather than assuming that conclusion.

source.place: Tag 09AL, bounded constructible derived comparison, together with the canonical constant-scalar realization interface.

proof.text: Use c=(id_Z,i), since a closed immersion is proper. The existing closedSupportCompactIso, constructed from the identity extension-by-zero adjunction and exact derived closed direct image, identifies compact support with S in the ordinary derived category. Apply specifiedExceptionalEtale_boundedBelow at this same compactification to Rν_* K and its specified ordinary etale right adjoint. Its inverse image is therefore bounded below of etale origin, giving the asserted property of B. Use the supplied FixedComparisonClassAdjunction for its natural Hom equivalences; its finite-amplitude bound is already encapsulated in the cited specified boundedness theorem, so no dimension is chosen here.

source.place: First paragraph: finite-amplitude boundedness of the etale adjoint and natural comparison Hom chain; Stacks Tag 09BM for exact closed direct image.

proof.text: Compose the support Hom bijection, the fully faithful D+ inclusion, precomposition with closedSupportCompactIso.hom, the exceptional Hom bijection and the inverse D+ inclusion. This gives natural equivalences e_T: Hom(T,B₀) ≃ Hom(T,B) on the full class of bounded-below etale-origin inputs. Construct φ=e_B₀(id) and ψ=e_B⁻¹(id). Naturality applied to φ and ψ gives both inverse equations, and naturality applied to f gives f ≫ φ=e_T(f). Unpack this equality to the required relation with closedSupportCompactIso.inv. For uniqueness, retain an etale antecedent of B₀ from step 1, specialize any other normalized isomorphism to T=B₀ and f=id, and cancel the compact-support isomorphism and the injective inverse exceptional Hom bijection. This is the direct identity-evaluation proof of Yoneda uniqueness, without constructing a separate co-Yoneda natural isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 001P, lemma-yoneda: evaluation at the identities and naturality.

proof.text: Naturality of the exceptional Hom bijection gives e_B₀⁻¹(φ)=F(φ) ≫ e_B⁻¹(id). Naturality of closedSupportCompactIso.inv changes S(φ) ≫ q_B⁻¹ into q_B₀⁻¹ ≫ F(φ). Substitute the preceding equation and then specialize the normalization from step 3 to T=B₀ and f=id. Full faithfulness sends preimage(id) to id, and the support adjunction sends id to its counit. The result is exactly the final counit equation.

source.place: First paragraph: naturality of the relative adjunction.

proof_origin.place: A9 Lean proof: finite-ring constructible origin, the specified exceptional boundedness theorem, and direct identity evaluation of the natural Hom bijections as in Stacks Tag 001P. No independent human-authored source for the full comparison is claimed.
